question: After the Eastmoney 60m source failed holdout #9/#10 for insufficient history, does the separately authorized and pinned Sina 60m source provide enough exact standard-retail A-share history to run unchanged Grade-A YOLO 1h latest-endpoint and recent session-4h LONG-only delivery configurations?

owner_authorization.preceding_request: 同意 #11/#12 用新浪 60m 继续
owner_authorization.interpreted_action: Authorize new holdout configurations #11 and #12 using the proposed AKShare-documented Sina 60m long-history source, after #9/#10 failed before model inference.
owner_authorization.authorization_received_at_market_state: 2026-09-02T15:29:37+08:00; the cash market had completed its 15:00 close, so both new configurations freeze at that completed endpoint.

single_variable_bundle: Owner explicitly authorized the two replacement configurations together. Relative to failed #9/#10, change the market-data provider/request and completed cutoff only: Sina 60m long history through the now-complete 15:00 close replaces insufficient Eastmoney 60m history. Universe, checkpoint, renderer, image size, W18/W19, confidence, NMS, structural mapping, semantic thresholds, LONG-only delivery and five-session 4h lookback remain fixed. No #9/#10 model result existed.

universe.rule: Keep only SH_MAIN/SZ_MAIN and exclude ST/*ST/S*ST/SST, PT, delisting-marker names and every extra-permission/unknown board.

minute_bars.raw_timestamp_semantics: Must prove close-labelled 60m slots exactly at 10:30, 11:30, 14:00 and 15:00 Asia/Shanghai; source open_time is the close-label minus one hour.

qfq.algorithm: Parse strict factor data without eval; for each session select the latest factor_date not later than the bar date, divide raw OHLC by qfq_factor, round to two decimals, and leave volume/amount unchanged.
qfq.causality: No later-dated factor row may be selected for a bar. The snapshot remains the byte authority because QFQ history can revise after later corporate actions.
qfq.missing_factor: Fail that symbol closed; never substitute factor 1.0.

session_4h.definition: Aggregate exactly the four same-date 60m rows at 10:30, 11:30, 14:00 and 15:00 into one four-trading-hour session bar with open_time=09:30 and available_at=15:00; never build a partial day or a continuous wall-clock 4h bucket.

preflight.sequence: Write #11/#12 consumption-start ledger, fetch Sina sh000001 only, verify at least 640 exact rows and 160 complete sessions through 15:00, then fetch two fixed QFQ sentinels and their Eastmoney overlap. Only after every check passes may the 3,111-name fanout begin.
preflight.reference_eastmoney_overlap: At least 100 exact shared close labels; median absolute close relative difference <=0.001 and p99 <=0.005.
preflight.qfq_sentinel_eastmoney_overlap: For each sentinel, at least 100 exact shared close labels; median absolute OHLC relative difference <=0.003 and p99 <=0.02.
preflight.failure_rule: Any failure is a consumed #11/#12 source failure, not zero signals. Do not switch provider, relax parity, or request individual symbols.

eligibility.1h: Latest close must be 2026-09-02 15:00 CST and the trailing 160 1h close labels must exactly match the frozen Sina reference schedule.
eligibility.4h: Latest complete session must close 2026-09-02 15:00 CST and the trailing 160 session closes must exactly match the aggregated frozen Sina reference dates.
eligibility.snapshot_gate: Each timeframe needs >=80% coverage of the 3,111-name universe; same-source minute/factor network failures must not exceed max(10, 1%). No missing bar is filled.

source_contract.phase_separation: Freeze reference, parity evidence, universe and all QFQ hourly CSV bytes before model load. Scan and verification have zero network reads.

model_contract.name: Grade-A 8k positives + 24k negatives, full40, native 1280
model_contract.causality: For every endpoint, features, exact W18/W19 pixels and semantic decisions use only rows whose close/availability is at or before that endpoint.

semantic_gate_contract.reuse: Exact frozen causal-prefix gate; no grid, tuning or post-result change.
semantic_gate_contract.direction_flip_null: Hold box/time/confidence fixed and recompute each structural proposal with LONG/SHORT inverted.

delivery_contract.audit: Run/count both detector classes, retain SHORT audit rows, never chart or deliver SHORT.
delivery_contract.identifier: Every delivered row/chart contains six-digit code plus SHxxxxxx or SZxxxxxx search key.
delivery_contract.four_hour_age: Exactly the five latest complete Sina-reference trading sessions through 2026-09-02; deduplicate under the frozen five-bar gap and record first/latest availability.
delivery_contract.zero_survivor_rule: Report zero honestly without changing thresholds, source parity, history, access filters or endpoints.

decision_and_reporting.economic_metrics: Not applicable: OOD detection snapshot without future A-share outcome labels, execution simulation, matched random entries or owner-confirmed A-share Gold. Use the frozen direction-flip semantic null.

reasons: Crypto-15m checkpoint applied to A-share 1h and session-4h images.
Provider, adjustment, market microstructure, session gaps and price limits differ from training.
The detector requires 2-9 post-core confirmation bars, so outputs are completed-history proposals.
risk_contract.language: OOD research proposals/model hits only; never recommendations, expected returns or profit probabilities.
